utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll stick to the plan and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check back in if I hear anything around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and just grab the repair-drive basics. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the basics and meet me at the garage when you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the basics and head to the garage when I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d double-check the timing and where it’s being held before you spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the timing and location first. Thanks, I didn’t want to pass on anything shaky.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I can help out, I just need a quick reminder of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on screws, duct tape, and one decent wrench. If you can bring any of that, it’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can bring screws and duct tape for sure. I’ll see if I can track down a decent wrench too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help—what details do we know about the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I don’t think we’ve nailed down much yet—just that it’s a repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—let’s get the basics first. What’s the date, location, and what kind of repairs are we collecting for?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a bit late, but I heard there’s a repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we still need a few hands for sorting the donated tools and checking in the appliances. If you’ve got time, I could really use you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in—point me to the tools, and I’ll help get the appliances checked in too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help me sort the donated tools and check what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a list of what’s still missing. I’ll let you know if I spot anything we need to track down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive location yet, but I can keep an eye out for it. If you hear any details, I’ll note them down right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep listening for the location and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll stay alert and jot it down as soon as it comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—folks are really showing up with tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—thank you! I’m already telling a few neighbors to swing by, and I’ll keep passing along the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific. It’s nice to see everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know when the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet—I haven’t heard the start time. If I find out, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rey. If you hear anything, just tell me—I want to make sure I don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll pass the word along to a few neighbors. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve just been hearing second-hand, so I’m not sure yet. If you hear a time, please let me know and I’ll help spread it too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around and share the time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. If you’re free, we can go over what needs fixing and who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa. I can help go over it, yes — just tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that’s a big help. I’ve got a few things to sort: the loose gate latch, a leaky faucet at the community room, and a couple of folks who already said they might be available.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools all morning. If you’re heading over, they could probably use an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I can stop by after lunch and help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, after lunch works perfectly. I’ll let them know you’re coming, and they’ll be glad for the help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Anything you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s going well so far — I’m just trying to keep the repair drive organized and on track. If you can help by sorting donations or loading boxes, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can sort donations and help load boxes. Point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you need an extra pair of hands. What’s the plan for today?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m just trying to sort the list and see what can actually get done today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you want, I can help sort the list and pick the quickest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll keep the tools ready for you at the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll have everything set out there this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—could you confirm what tools and supplies you already have, and whether you’re available this Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got a basic toolkit, some screws, and a drill I can bring. Saturday morning works for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I’m a bit behind—what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Nothing major changed — we’re still gathering the broken items and tools, and I’m just trying to keep everyone posted. If you want, I can catch you up on what’s been assigned.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please—just the quick version so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, Gus, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. If you spot anyone who needs a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll pass along anyone who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and remind folks we need a screwdriver set and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep an eye out for a screwdriver set and some work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Leo — I appreciate it. If I hear of any other donations, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the exact drop-off time and where the repairs are being collected.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia — drop-off is Saturday at 10 a.m., and we’re collecting repairs at the community center front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I can make Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it today—come by if you can, and I’ll make sure you’re on the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stop by and make sure I’m on the invite list. If you need anything for the repair drive, I’ve got some supplies on hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Cleo—bring whatever you can spare, and I’ll let everyone know you’re helping out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup, but I’ll need the address again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — sorry, I keep forgetting it. I’ll text you the address in just a minute.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — that works for me. I’ll look out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — let’s get the repair drive moving. I can help organize the list and see what needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so a clear list would really help. I can keep an eye out and pass along anything I hear.
